symptoms: Assessment of Pain via QUESTT: Question the patient, Use age + developmentally appropriate pain-rating scale (FLACC for 2 mo - 4 yr, Wong-Baker FACES for > 4 yr), Evaluate behaviour + physiological changes, Secure parental involvement, Take cause into account, Take action + evaluate response.
Pain Score Interpretation: 0 No pain, 1-3 Mild pain, 4-6 Moderate pain, 7-10 Severe pain.

management_steps.details: Glucose 25% oral solution: 2ml PO STAT (useful for neonates + infants). Paracetamol (Panado) 120mg/5ml, 500mg tab; Rectal 125mg, 250mg supp: Kids 15-20mg/kg PO STAT (Birth - 2 mo max 60mg/kg/day divided TDS/QID; >2 mo 90mg/kg/day max 4g/day); Adults 1.5G PO STAT then 1G PO QID (Dose on ideal body weight). Ibuprofen (Brufen) 100mg/5ml, 200mg/400mg tabs: 10mg/kg STAT (Kids + adults 5-10mg/kg PO TDS with food). Mefenamic acid (Ponstan) 50mg/ml, 250mg cap, 500mg tab, 125mg supp: Kids 6.5-7.5 mg/kg STAT (6.5-7.5mg PO TDS); Kids 6mo-2yr 125mg PR STAT (TDS, not > 48 hours); Adults 500mg STAT (500mg PO TDS).

Use medication for mild pain + consider addition of: Tramadol (Tramal) 50mg tab, 100mg amp: Oral 0.5-1 mg/kg STAT; IV 1-1.5 mg/kg STAT (max 8 mg/kg daily, max 400mg/day). Diclofenac (Voltaren) 75mg amp: Adults (>50kg) 75mg IMI; Off-label IV: 1 mg/kg IVI diluted slowly in 5 ml/kg crystalloid. Myprodol (Paracetamol 500mg + Ibuprofen 200mg + Codeine 10mg): Adults 2 caps STAT (2 caps TDS/QID); Kids 3-5 yr 5ml PO STAT (2.5-5ml TDS/QID), 6-12 yr 10ml PO STAT (5-10ml TDS/QID).

Perfalgan 10mg/ml IV: < 1 mo 10mg/kg STAT (max 40mg/kg/day divided TDS/QID); > 1 mo 15 mg/kg STAT (max 60mg/kg/day, max 4g/day); Adults 1G IVI TDS/QID. Fentanyl 100ug/2ml: IV 1-1.5ug stat (dilute 1 amp with 8ml saline/WFI = 10ug/ml); IN atomised 1-2ug/kg STAT; Transmucosal 10-15ug/kg. Morphine 5mg/ml, 10mg/ml, 15mg/ml: IV/IO 0.1-0.15 mg/kg (Loading dose 0.05mg/kg IV/IO over 3-5 mins, dose intervals 3-5 mins, titrate in 0.025-0.05mg/kg increments); IM <50kg 0.1mg/kg STAT, >50kg 0.1-0.2mg/kg STAT; Oral 10mg/5ml syrup 0.25-0.5 mg/kg 4 hrly (refer to dosing table). Meperidine (Pethidine) 25mg/ml, 50mg/ml, 100mg/2ml: IMI <50kg 1mg/kg STAT, Adults >50kg 75-100mg IMI STAT; IV/IO 0.25-0.5mg/kg IVI. Ketamine 10mg/ml, 50mg/ml, 100mg/ml: IV/IO 0.25 mg/kg STAT (0.1-0.3mg/kg); IM 1-2 mg/kg; Oral 1-2mg/kg; Rectal 1-2.5mg/kg; IN atomized 1.5-2.5mg/kg.

warnings: Ibuprofen and Mefenamic acid are C/I in pregnancy.
Diclofenac is C/I in pregnancy, AKI, polytrauma, hypotension.
Tramadol is highly emetogenic and lowers seizure threshold.
Morphine syrup in infants <2kg: caution! apnoea is a real risk.
